# K12

> K12, powered by Stride, Inc. (NYSE: LRN), has provided online education since 2000. K12 offers tuition-free online public schools in many states, tuition-based online private school, homeschool curriculum, tutoring, and career and college prep for students in grades K-12, plus online preschool.

Key facts:
- Online public schools powered by K12 are tuition-free for families. Availability depends on the student's state and district; use the School Finder to see options.
- K12 Private Academy and other private options are tuition-based and available nationwide and outside the U.S.
- Students learn with certified teachers trained in virtual instruction, a mix of scheduled live classes and self-paced work, and K12 curriculum. Most schools provide books and learning materials; some provide a computer.
- A parent or other responsible adult serves as the Learning Coach.
- K12 has served more than 3 million registered learners across its managed public schools, private schools, and Learning Solutions.
- Enrollment help: 866.968.7512. Spanish-language site: https://es.k12.com/

## About K12
- [About K12](https://www.k12.com/about-k12/): Company overview and history
- [What Sets K12 Apart](https://www.k12.com/why-k12/): Why families choose K12
- [Accreditation](https://www.k12.com/about-k12/accreditation/): Accreditation of K12-powered schools
- [Meet the Teachers](https://www.k12.com/about-k12/meet-the-teachers/): Certified teachers and how they support students
- [Types of Learners We Serve](https://www.k12.com/about-k12/types-of-learners-k12-serves/): Who online school is a fit for
- [Military Families](https://www.k12.com/about-k12/military-families/): Online school for families who relocate
- [Our Curriculum](https://www.k12.com/steps-to-success/k12-curriculum/): K12 curriculum approach and subjects
- [FAQ](https://www.k12.com/faq/): Answers to common parent questions

## How Online School Works
- [How Online Learning Works](https://www.k12.com/how-online-learning-works/): Daily structure, live classes, and self-paced work
- [A Day in the Life](https://www.k12.com/day-in-the-life/): What a typical school day looks like
- [Role of the Learning Coach](https://www.k12.com/how-online-learning-works/role-of-the-learning-coach/): What parents and guardians do
- [Personalized Learning](https://www.k12.com/how-online-learning-works/personalized-learning/): How instruction adapts to each student
- [Flex Program](https://www.k12.com/how-online-learning-works/flex-program/): Flexible scheduling option
- [Online vs. Traditional Public School](https://www.k12.com/why-k12/online-vs-traditional-public-school/): Side-by-side comparison
- [Socialization](https://www.k12.com/socialization/): How online students make friends and connect
- [Extracurricular Activities](https://www.k12.com/extracurricular-activities/): Clubs, events, and esports
- [Student Safety](https://www.k12.com/student-safety/): Safety, bullying prevention, and mental health resources

## School Options
- [Compare Schooling Options](https://www.k12.com/find-right-online-learning-for-you/): Public, private, homeschool, and tutoring compared
- [Online Public Schools](https://www.k12.com/online-public-schools/): Tuition-free online public school, grades K-12
- [Online Private School](https://www.k12.com/online-private-school/): Tuition-based private school at home
- [How to Make Private School Free](https://www.k12.com/online-private-school/how-to-make-private-school-free/): Vouchers, scholarships, and state funding for private school
- [Online Homeschool](https://www.k12.com/online-homeschool/): Homeschool courses and curriculum
- [Homeschool Costs](https://www.k12.com/online-homeschool/costs/): Pricing for K12 homeschool curriculum
- [Buy Individual Online Courses](https://www.k12.com/buy-individual-online-courses/): Single courses for homeschool or supplemental learning
- [Free Homeschool Lessons](https://www.k12.com/online-homeschool/learninghub/): Free at-home enrichment from K12
- [Online Preschool](https://www.k12.com/online-preschool/): Prekindergarten at home
- [Live Online Tutoring](https://www.k12.com/live-online-tutoring/): 1:1 tutoring
- [Online Summer School](https://www.k12.com/online-summer-school/): Summer courses
- [Adult Learning](https://www.k12.com/adult-learning/): Programs for adult learners
- [Midyear Transfer](https://www.k12.com/midyear-transfer/): Switching to online school during the school year

## Academics by Grade
- [Online Elementary School](https://www.k12.com/online-public-elementary-school/): Grades K-5
- [Online Kindergarten](https://www.k12.com/online-public-elementary-school/online-kindergarten/)
- [Elementary Course List](https://www.k12.com/online-public-elementary-school/elementary-school-offerings/elementary-school-courses/)
- [Online Middle School](https://www.k12.com/online-public-middle-school/): Grades 6-8
- [Middle School Course List](https://www.k12.com/online-public-schools/middle-school/middle-school-courses/)
- [Online Eighth Grade](https://www.k12.com/online-public-middle-school/online-eighth-grade/)
- [Online High School](https://www.k12.com/online-public-high-school/): Grades 9-12
- [Online Ninth Grade](https://www.k12.com/online-public-high-school/online-ninth-grade/)
- [High School Course List](https://www.k12.com/online-public-schools/high-school/high-school-courses/)
- [High School Electives](https://www.k12.com/online-public-high-school/high-school-offerings/high-school-electives/)
- [AP and Honors](https://www.k12.com/online-public-high-school/ap-honors-courses/): Advanced high school courses
- [Dual Enrollment](https://www.k12.com/online-public-high-school/dual-enrollment/): Earning college credit in high school
- [Credit Recovery](https://www.k12.com/online-public-high-school/credit-recovery/): Making up high school credits
- [High School Diploma](https://www.k12.com/online-public-high-school/high-school-diploma/): Earning a diploma online
- [Advanced Learner Program](https://www.k12.com/online-public-schools/advanced-learners/): Gifted and advanced students
- [Special Education](https://www.k12.com/special-education/): Special education services in online school
- [STEM Education](https://www.k12.com/stem-education/): STEM courses and programs

## Career and College Prep
- [Career and College Prep Program](https://www.k12.com/career-and-college-prep/): Overview of career pathways in high school
- [Career Fields](https://www.k12.com/career-and-college-prep/career-prep/career-fields/): How the program works by career field
- [Certifications](https://www.k12.com/career-and-college-prep/career-prep/offerings-curriculum-and-services/certifications/): Industry certifications students can earn
- [College Prep](https://www.k12.com/career-and-college-prep/college-prep/): College planning support
- [Graduate Success](https://www.k12.com/steps-to-success/graduate-success/): Outcomes for K12 graduates

## Enrollment
- [Find a School](https://www.k12.com/schoolfinder/): Search K12-powered schools by location
- [How to Enroll](https://www.k12.com/find-a-school/how-to-enroll/): Steps to enroll in online school
- [Enrollment Checklist](https://www.k12.com/find-a-school/how-to-enroll/enrollment-checklist/): Documents and requirements
- [International Online Schools](https://www.k12.com/international-online-schools/): Options outside the U.S.
- [Contact Us](https://www.k12.com/contact-us/): Enrollment and general questions

## Parent Guides
- [Are Online Public Schools Free?](https://www.k12.com/how-online-learning-works/are-online-public-schools-free/): What is included and what families provide
- [How Much Does Online School Cost?](https://www.k12.com/tips-support-for-parents/how-much-does-online-school-cost/): Public, private, and homeschool cost comparison
- [Homeschool vs. Online School](https://www.k12.com/how-online-learning-works/homeschool-vs-online-school/): Key differences
- [What Parents Can Expect From Online School](https://www.k12.com/how-online-learning-works/what-parents-can-expect-from-online-school/)
- [How an Online School Day Is Structured](https://www.k12.com/how-online-learning-works/online-school-day-structure/): Live classes vs. independent work
- [The Parent's Role in Online School](https://www.k12.com/tips-support-for-parents/parent-role-online-school/)
- [Is Self-Paced Online School an Option?](https://www.k12.com/how-online-learning-works/self-paced-online-school/)
- [How Online Schools Track Progress](https://www.k12.com/tips-support-for-parents/online-school-progress-tracking/)
- [Online Curriculum by Grade Level](https://www.k12.com/what-kids-are-learning/online-curriculum-by-grade-level/)
- [Is Your Child Ready for Online Learning?](https://www.k12.com/tips-support-for-parents/is-your-child-ready-for-online-learning/)
- [Before Enrolling in Online School](https://www.k12.com/tips-support-for-parents/before-enrolling-in-online-school/)
- [Online School Enrollment Timeline](https://www.k12.com/how-online-learning-works/online-school-enrollment-timeline/)
- [Switching to Online School Midyear](https://www.k12.com/how-online-learning-works/switch-to-online-school-mid-year/)
- [IEP Services in Online School](https://www.k12.com/how-online-learning-works/online-school-iep-services/)
- [504 Accommodations in Online School](https://www.k12.com/study-resources/504-accommodations-online-school/)
- [Online School Support for ADHD](https://www.k12.com/tips-support-for-parents/adhd-online-school-support/)
- [Online School Support for Autism](https://www.k12.com/k12-community/online-school-autism-support/)
- [Online High School Diploma Accreditation](https://www.k12.com/what-kids-are-learning/online-high-school-diploma-accreditation/)
- [Do Colleges Accept Online Diplomas?](https://www.k12.com/study-resources/online-diplomas-accepted-by-colleges/)
- [Online High School Graduation Requirements](https://www.k12.com/tips-support-for-parents/online-high-school-graduation-requirements/)
- [Graduating High School Faster Online](https://www.k12.com/how-online-learning-works/graduate-high-school-faster-online/)

data-group-id="a4364f3d" data-field-span="12"><script>
(() => {
  const form = document.querySelector('#modal-moreinfo form')
  const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search)

  if (!form || !urlParams.has('ab') || form.hasAttribute('data-ab')) return

  const modalDesc = document.querySelector('#modal-moreinfo > div > p')
  form.setAttribute('data-ab', '1')

  if (modalDesc) {
    modalDesc.innerHTML = modalDesc.innerHTML
    .replace(/\s*\(All fields are required\)\s*/g, ' ')
    .trim()
  }

  const phone = document.querySelector('.sf-lead-phone input')
  const phoneOptional = document.querySelector('.sf-lead-phone-optional input')
  const phoneIntl = document.querySelector('.sf-lead-phone-intl input')
  const phoneIntlOptional = document.querySelector('.sf-lead-phone-intl-optional input')
  const state = document.querySelector('.sf-lead-state select')

  const hideRequiredPhone = () => {
    setTimeout(() => {
      phone.closest('.gfield').style.display = 'none'
      phoneIntl.closest('.gfield').style.display = 'none'
    }, 100)
  }

  const fillEmptyPhone = (event) => {
    if (window.getComputedStyle(phoneOptional.closest('.gfield')).display !== 'none') {
      phoneIntl.value = phoneOptional?.value?.trim() ? phoneOptional.value : '0000000000'
    }

    if (window.getComputedStyle(phoneIntlOptional.closest('.gfield')).display !== 'none') {
      phoneIntl.value = phoneIntlOptional?.value?.trim() ? phoneIntlOptional.value : '0000000000'
    }

    phoneIntl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
  }

  const prefixIntlPhone = () => {
    if (phoneIntlOptional.value.trim() && !phoneIntlOptional.value.trim().startsWith('+')) {
      phoneIntlOptional.value = `+${phoneIntlOptional.value.trim()}`
    }
  }

  const init = () => {
    hideRequiredPhone()
    phoneIntlOptional.setAttribute('maxlength', '15')

    state.addEventListener('change', hideRequiredPhone)

    const phoneEvents = ['keyup', 'input', 'blur']
    const intlPhoneHandlers = [prefixIntlPhone, fillEmptyPhone]

    phoneEvents.forEach((_event) => {
      phoneOptional.addEventListener(_event, fillEmptyPhone)
    })

    intlPhoneHandlers.forEach((fn) => {
      phoneEvents.forEach((_event) => {
        phoneIntlOptional.addEventListener(_event, fn)
      })
    })

    const originalHandleButtonClick = gform.submission.handleButtonClick;

    gform.submission.handleButtonClick = function (event, form) {
      fillEmptyPhone(event);

      return originalHandleButtonClick.apply(this, arguments);
    }

    form.addEventListener('submit', fillEmptyPhone)
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init)
  } else {
    init()
  }
})()

    <script>
    // Simple root-domain detector: last two labels (works for k12.com, cava.k12.com, etc.)
    // If you use country-TLDs like example.co.uk, adjust the rule or provide a fixed root.
    function getRootDomain(hostname) {
      var parts = hostname.split('.');
      if (parts.length >= 2) {
        return parts.slice(-2).join('.');
      }
      return hostname;
    }

    function clearAllSiteStorage() {
      try { localStorage.clear(); } catch(e) {}
      try { sessionStorage.clear(); } catch(e) {}
      console.log('🧹 localStorage and sessionStorage cleared');
    }

    function clearAllCookiesForHostAndRoot() {
      var host = window.location.hostname;      // e.g. cava.k12.com
      var root = getRootDomain(host);          // e.g. k12.com
      var domains = [
        host,          // exact host
        '.' + root,    // root domain with leading dot
        root           // plain root (covers some legacy cookies)
      ];

      // Build path variants from current path down to root
      var paths = ['/'];
      var segments = window.location.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean);
      if (segments.length) {
        var acc = '';
        segments.forEach(function(seg) {
          acc += '/' + seg;
          paths.push(acc);
        });
      }

      var raw = document.cookie;
      if (!raw) {
        console.log('ℹ️ No document.cookie entries visible to JS');
        return;
      }

      var cookies = raw.split(';');
      var cleared = [];

      cookies.forEach(function (cookie) {
        var name = cookie.split('=')[0].trim();
        // Try deleting across domain and path permutations
        domains.forEach(function (dom) {
          paths.forEach(function (p) {
            // with domain
            document.cookie = name + '=; Expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT; Path=' + p + '; Domain=' + dom + '; SameSite=Lax';
            // without domain (host-only)
            document.cookie = name + '=; Expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT; Path=' + p + '; SameSite=Lax';
          });
        });
        cleared.push(name);
      });

      console.log('✅ Attempted to clear cookies for host "' + host + '" and root "' + root + '".');
      console.log('➡️ Names cleared: ', cleared);
      console.log('⚠️ Note: HttpOnly cookies and cookies set on different parent domains cannot be cleared by JS.');
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
      var olsLoginLink = document.querySelector('li.osl-login a');
      if (!olsLoginLink) {
        console.log('❌ Could not find OLS Login link');
        return;
      }

      olsLoginLink.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault(); // control timing
        var url = this.href;
        console.log('🔁 OLS Login clicked, starting client-side reset…');

        clearAllCookiesForHostAndRoot();
        clearAllSiteStorage();

        // Optional cache-busting reload of current page in background feel
        // comment out if you do not want the current page to reload
        try {
          history.replaceState(null, '', window.location.pathname + '?cachebust=' + Date.now());
        } catch(e) {}

        // Open the OLS in a new tab after a short tick
        setTimeout(function () {
          window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener');
          console.log('🚀 Opened OLS:', url);
        }, 50);
      });
    });

document.addEventListener('change', function(e){
    const input = e.target;

    // Only Gravity Forms single file upload fields
    if(input.matches('input[type="file"][id^="input_"]')) {
        const file = input.files[0];
        const maxKB = 250;

        // Remove old error messages every time user selects a file
        const container = input.closest('.ginput_container_fileupload');
        container.querySelectorAll('.file-size-error').forEach(el => el.remove());

        if(file && file.size > maxKB * 1024) {

            // Remove preview if exists
            const preview = container.querySelector('.ginput_preview');
            if(preview) preview.remove();

            // Reset file input
            input.value = "";

            // Insert custom inline error message
            const errorMsg = document.createElement('div');
            errorMsg.className = 'file-size-error';
            errorMsg.style.color = '#d63638';
            errorMsg.style.fontSize = '13px';
            errorMsg.style.marginTop = '6px';
            errorMsg.textContent = `File must be less than ${maxKB} KB`;

            container.appendChild(errorMsg);
        }
    }
});

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){

    const maxText = "Max. file size: 250KB";

    document.querySelectorAll('.gfield_description, .ginput_container_fileupload .gfield_fileupload_rules')

            // Replace only the size part; keep file type info untouched

});

    const startField = $(".k12-event-date input");

    if(!startField.length || !endField.length) return;

    // Today's date
    const today = new Date();
    today.setHours(0,0,0,0);

    // Start Date Picker
    startField.datepicker({
        dateFormat: "yy/mm/dd",
        showAnim: "slideDown",
        minDate: today, // disable previous dates
        beforeShow: function(input, inst){
            setTimeout(function(){
                $("#ui-datepicker-div").addClass("event-calendar");
            }, 0);
        },
        onClose: function(selectedDate){
            if(selectedDate){
                let start = startField.datepicker("getDate");

                // Apply minDate to End Date
                endField.datepicker("option", "minDate", start);

                let end = endField.datepicker("getDate");
                if(end && end < start){
                    endField.val(""); // reset invalid date
                }
            }
        }
    });

    // End Date Picker

        dateFormat: "yy/mm/dd",
        showAnim: "slideDown",
        minDate: today,
        beforeShow: function(input, inst){
            setTimeout(function(){
                $("#ui-datepicker-div").addClass("event-calendar");
            }, 0);
        }
    });

});

					.replace(/[^\w\s-]/g, '')
					.replace(/\s+/g, '-')

					a.innerText = title;
	
					// Append the link to the list item
					li.appendChild(a);

					if (level === 2) {
						// For H2 headings, directly append to ul
						ul.appendChild(li);
